versions.changelog:
Initial release of Agent Creator Suite for OpenClaw.

- Enables end-to-end design and generation of OpenClaw agent workspaces with strong defaults.
- Interactive workflow: guides through clarifying questions, then auto-generates required workspace files (IDENTITY.md, SOUL.md, AGENTS.md, USER.md, HEARTBEAT.md, etc.).
- Includes advanced guardrails checklist and best practices for agent safety and behavior.
- Supports iteration on existing agents with targeted updates and minimal changes.
- Provides scenario-based acceptance tests for validating agent performance.
